::: {#exm-self-attention}

#### Self-attention over "First Citizen"

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
_ = torch.manual_seed(0)
embed = nn.Embedding(n_chars, 8)
attend = nn.MultiheadAttention(embed_dim=8, num_heads=1, batch_first=True)
line = ids[:13].unsqueeze(0)
n_line = line.shape[1]
with torch.no_grad():
    x = embed(line)
    self_out, self_weights = attend(x, x, x)
print(repr(text[:13]))
print(self_out.shape, self_weights.shape)
```

The first line of the text begins with the `r py$n_line` characters `"First Citizen"`.
An [embedding layer](rnns.qmd#def-embedding) turns each into a vector of 8 numbers,
and passing the same [tensor](pytorch-basics.qmd#def-tensor) as queries, keys and values makes `nn.MultiheadAttention` compute [self-attention](#def-self-attention).
The weights form a $`r py$n_line` \times `r py$n_line`$ matrix:
one row of weights over all `r py$n_line` characters for each character.

:::
